records.name: Cathedral Childcare
records.notes: Held back on purpose: no summary, categories or interests, because it is not established what this IRS entity runs. Its address matches the cathedral office address on philadelphiacathedral.org, which lists an Early Learning Center with no hours, fees or enrollment details and links to a third party site. The cathedral church itself is open to the public (Sunday worship at 10 am, noonday services on Wednesdays and Fridays, a newcomers form, and events dated Friday, October 9 and Sunday, October 11, 2026). Suggest a separate record for Philadelphia Episcopal Cathedral with its own group id, and a separate check of the Early Learning Center. The site prints info@philadelphiacathedral.org and 215-386-0234, but its email link points to a different address. Legal name: Cathedral Childcare Inc.

records.name: Coded by
records.summary: Nonprofit that teaches free tech workshops to students in grades 6 to 12, from first lines of code to building a startup idea.
records.what_you_do: Pick a workshop, such as coding basics, 3D animation, or app redesign, and register on its program page. Workshops are held at its Market Street offices and at Temple University.

schedule.text: Workshops this fall, with registration open on each program page

cost.text: Free for students at all skill levels.

first_step.how: Open the workshop you want on codedby.org and use its registration link. No prior skill is needed.
first_step.basis: The site says the programs need no prerequisite and each workshop has its own registration link.

records.notes: IRS list name is Coded by, also known as Coded by Kids. The old codedbykids.com domain returned a 301 redirect to codedby.org, which carries the same name, so it was followed. No phone or email is published, only the Market Street address. Ages are grades 6 to 12 as published, with no minimum age given. Interests are the closest tags available.

records.name: C.H.A.N.G.E.
records.summary: Mental health counseling and community workshops for youth, adults, and families, run by a nonprofit from an office on Lancaster Avenue.
records.what_you_do: Ask about counseling or a workshop through the contact form on the website or by phone.

schedule.text: Office hours are 9 am to 5 pm. The site does not list the days.

cost.text: The site does not say whether services are free or have a fee. Donations are accepted.

first_step.how: Use the contact form on the website, or call the office between 9 am and 5 pm to ask about counseling or workshops.
first_step.basis: The site lists counseling and workshops but gives no intake steps, days or dates, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Legal name: Community Helping All Needing Growth Everywhere Inc. The site lists workshop programs and services with no details. The 2026 copyright footer is not used as evidence, and there are no dated items, so status is probably_active from a working site alone. The page spells the city 'Philadelpha'. The phone uses a New Jersey area code as printed.

records.name: Condo Community Development Group
records.notes: Held back: no summary. The website did not resolve (DNS failure). Also known as Condo Reconciliation Group. records.name: Educated Sistas Association
records.summary: Women's association that holds quarterly meetings and has listed college fair trips, aimed at education and opportunity for women and girls.
records.what_you_do: Attend a quarterly meeting or a college fair, or sign up on the site for monthly email updates.

cost.text: The site lists no admission or registration fees and asks for donations.

first_step.how: Email info@educatedsista.org to ask whether the quarterly meeting still runs and when the next one is.
first_step.basis: Public meetings and monthly updates are listed, but the newest dated event is from January 2024, so it is unclear whether it still meets.

records.notes: Newest dated event is a quarterly meeting on January 20, 2024. Most listed events are from 2018 and 2019, and the footer copyright is 2018, which is not evidence. Status is dormant. The Girard Avenue address is listed for the quarterly meeting, not confirmed as the office. Membership details are not published. Legal name matches the IRS list.

records.name: Embracing God's Angels
records.summary: Nonprofit that supports families after a hit and run crash, with help for funeral and medical costs, family advocates for court hearings, and a push for safer neighborhoods.
records.what_you_do: Call or text to volunteer, or ask for help through the contact form. The group also runs a crisis response team that meets with families after a hit and run.

schedule.text: Office open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm. Visits are by appointment, arranged by email.

cost.text: Help is based on criteria and no fee is stated. Donations are optional.

first_step.how: Call or text 267-732-5955 to volunteer, or use the contact form to ask for help.
first_step.basis: The site lists a phone and text line for volunteers and describes the help offered to families.

records.notes: The site has no dated items, so status is probably_active from a working site alone. The 2018 copyright footer is not used as evidence. Two email addresses appear on the site; the one on the group's own domain is recorded. A second phone number for the founder is on the site and was not recorded. The site spells the name God's; the IRS list uses Gods.

records.name: Emmanuel Advancement Center
records.summary: Nonprofit offering tutoring, adult education, career planning and job placement, mentoring, and health and wellness help, started through a request form.
records.what_you_do: Request tutoring, adult education, career planning, mentoring, or wellness help through the site's forms, or learn about volunteering on the volunteer page.

cost.text: The site does not state fees.

first_step.how: Fill out the Request More Information form on the site for tutoring, career planning, mentoring, or health and wellness.
first_step.basis: Starts with a request form, and the site lists no dates, eligibility or fees, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The site has a News and Events link but no dated items, so status is probably_active from a working site alone. Eligibility is not stated; open_to public reflects that the request forms are open to anyone who asks. An Immersion Program is listed without details. Facebook link recorded as printed on the site, including its spelling. Address not published.

records.name: Equity Solutions Svcs II
records.notes: Paid training business: prices are given only on request, bookings go through member accounts, and the office is at 426 East Allegheny Avenue. The site mentions youth and summer programs with no details, so it is not counted as a community program. Not a group under the rules for businesses with no community program.

records.name: Ethiopian Community Association of Greater Philadelphia
records.summary: Community association for Ethiopians in Greater Philadelphia that shares health and mental health resources, runs a young adults program, and works to keep Ethiopian culture alive for children.
records.what_you_do: Join through the membership page, check the events page for gatherings, or volunteer through the contact page.

schedule.text: Office open Monday to Thursday, 10 am to 2 pm. A board election was listed for Sunday, May 17, 2026, from 2 to 6 pm.

cost.text: The site lists no membership fee. Donations are accepted and described as tax deductible.

first_step.how: Use the Membership page on ethiophilly.org, or call +1 (267) 969-3771 Monday to Thursday, 10 am to 2 pm, to ask how to join.
first_step.basis: The site has a membership page and posted office hours, though it does not state dues.

records.notes: Batch website was typed as 'https:ethiophilly.org', which is malformed; the working domain ethiophilly.org was used. The site's email link points to a different placeholder address, so the Gmail address is recorded as the staff contact; verify before relying on it. The membership page was not read in full, so dues are unconfirmed.

records.name: Girls Justice League
records.summary: Girls' rights group in Philadelphia, run by young women and their allies, with a Saturday program and a summer institute for girls and young women ages 14 to 24.
records.what_you_do: Email to get involved in girls' rights projects and activism, and take part in the Saturday or summer institute if they are running.

cost.text: No program cost is stated on the site. A donation link is offered.

first_step.how: Email catherine.sui@girlsjusticeleague.org with the subject line Join Us! to ask about getting involved.
first_step.basis: Joining is by email only, and the newest program page is from 2021, so it is unclear whether programs still run.

records.notes: Newest dated items: a program page titled Saturday Institute 2021 (year only, so no month is recorded) and a March 2018 quote on the home page. Copyright footers are not used. Ages 14 to 24 are as stated for involvement; the schema has no maximum age. Program dates are not shown on the pages read. Newsletter signup form on the site appears not to be working.

records.name: Helping Hands Ministry
records.summary: Faith-based ministry that helps seniors and their caregivers with eldercare information, referrals, and a benevolence fund, mostly in Southwest and West Philadelphia.
records.what_you_do: Call the 24-hour prayer line or use the contact page to ask for caregiver help or a referral. The site says services are free.

schedule.text: 24-hour prayer line. The benevolence fund is offered as funds are available.

cost.text: Services are free. The benevolence fund depends on available funds.

first_step.how: Call the 24-hour prayer line at 1-480-553-0487 to ask about caregiver help.
first_step.basis: Anyone can ask for help, but no volunteer or membership path is described on the site.

records.notes: Founding year conflicts on the site: a 2001 banner, a founder account of 2000, and an incorporation date of July 14, 2004. The footer copyright range is not used as evidence, and there are no dated items, so status is probably_active from a working site alone. The benevolence application steps are not explained. No exact interest tag exists for caregiver referrals, so friendly_visiting was chosen as the closest. Street address not published.

notes: Budget: 2 of 2 WebSearch calls used; 17 WebFetch calls used (14 first pass, 3 follow-up). Redirect followed: codedbykids.com to codedby.org (same group name). Redirect not followed: childusadvocacy.org to an unrelated church domain. Batch website fields that were not usable: 'https:ethiophilly.org' (malformed; ethiophilly.org used) and '1986' (treated as missing for Families Are Victims Too). Verdicts: 14 publish (8 with content, 6 held back as unknown with no summary: Cathedral Childcare, Child USAdvocacy, Christ of Calvary CDC, Condo Community Development Group, Families Are Victims Too, Housing Finance Information Network), 1 not_a_group (Equity Solutions Svcs II). Status among the 8 with content: 2 active (Coded by, Ethiopian Community Association), 2 dormant (Educated Sistas, Girls Justice League), 4 probably_active (C.H.A.N.G.E., Embracing God's Angels, Emmanuel Advancement Center, Helping Hands Ministry). Searches ran out before Child USAdvocacy and Condo Community Development Group could be searched. Key follow-up: the Philadelphia Episcopal Cathedral church (philadelphiacathedral.org) is open to the public and was verified on its own site, but it is not recorded under the Cathedral Childcare IRS id; it needs its own group record.
